answers.core: As far as I can tell this can't be done in GDScript and generally makes sense as part of the WebRTC exposed ecosystem.
answers.workaround: I tried, but the best I could come up with remained limited to the polling interval. So to a degree a 'low accuracy' ping is viable, but hard to ensure it behaves consistently across machines.

title: Add real P2P Ping to WebRTC - Exposing currentRoundTripTime
